subject: Lumos integration — margin allocation, lead registration & onboarding steps
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@lumos.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership inquiry — Lumos <> Redwood integration commercial outline

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks for taking a look. Glad to connect — Lumos builds an observability + policy layer for model-driven applications and we've seen a number of mutual customers ask for tighter pre-built connectors to your hosted inference endpoints.

High-level ask: we'd like to propose a commercial framework for a co-sell/resale path where Lumos bundles Redwood in trials and pilots and we credit and split revenue on conversions. Key things we'd like to resolve quickly: ideal revenue split for pilot->paid conversion, lead registration window (how long a registered lead is exclusive), and demo/POC crediting for early-stage deals.

I attached a simple schedule with our baseline asks — it shows a tiered commission starting at 30% for first-year ARR and steps down as ACV scales. Happy to walk through next week.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call to align commercial guardrails and map a mutual action plan. Are you available Wed or Thu afternoon?

Attachment: Lumos_Share_Schedule.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships, Lumos.ai
elena@lumos.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
Lumos Partnerships <partnerships@lumos.ai>
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — Lumos <> Redwood integration commercial outline

Elena — thanks for the note and the schedule.

We like the idea of a sanitized pilot path that preserves lead ownership while allowing Lumos to package Redwood for trials. A few items we need clarified before the call so we can come prepared: 
- Commercial: baseline split you proposed and whether the split is gross ARR or net after discounts/credits.
- Lead registration: what constitutes a registered lead (form + PO?); suggested exclusivity window and a process for disputes.
- Demo / POC credits: are you proposing a per-demo credit (flat dollar) or % offset on first invoice?
- Legal/PO templates: is Lumos able to accept Redwood's standard reseller addendum, or do you require a Lumos-first contract?

I've attached a MAP template we use for joint pilots — fills out responsibilities, milestones, and who owns which deliverables. Can Marissa and Karthik join the call to cover comp/ops and technical integration expectations?

I'm available Thu 5/4 2–4pm or Fri 5/5 9–11am PT. Let me know what works and we'll book.

Attachment: MAP-template.docx (editable)

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — Lumos <> Redwood integration commercial outline

Grace — thanks for the questions. Quick answers inline: 

- Split basis: Lumos prefers a gross ARR share on first-year net ARR (after discounts but before platform fees). We can show model examples; the schedule attached on 5/1 assumes gross-first-year.
- Registered lead: we have a simple registration form (link below) + an intake email that captures company, key contacts, and estimated ARR. If Redwood's SDRs or AEs find the prospect first, we expect a 7-day handback window for triage; otherwise registrations hold for 90 days.
- Demo credits: for pilots under $50k we propose a flat demo credit of $2,500 applied against the first invoice; for >$50k deals a 5% first-invoice credit.
- Contracts: Lumos can accept Redwood's reseller addendum in most cases but will ask for minor warranty clarifications.

We're generally comfortable with a stepped share: 30% first-year for ARR < $100k, 20% for $100k–$500k, 10% beyond. We want an anchor program where Lumos-run demos count as partner-sourced for registration purposes.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bLumosDealReg (registration form prototype)

Would be great to get the call on Fri 5/5 at 10am PT if that works. If so we'll send calendar invite and a short deck.

— Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@lumos.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — Lumos <> Redwood integration commercial outline

Elena / Lumos Partnerships team — great discussion last week and thanks for the draft registration form. Per internal ops and our rev-share playbook, here's a concise proposal we can take to legal and ops for finalization: 

1) Revenue split: 60/40 Redwood:Lumos on first-year net ARR for partner-sourced or jointly-sourced registered deals (Redwood retains 60%). Steps: 30% for Lumos only applies to Lumos-exclusive sourced deals less than $100k ARR; for joint-source we default to the 60/40.
2) Registration window: 90 days exclusive from the date of accepted registration. 7-day triage handback if Redwood already has an active outbound thread.
3) Demo credits: $2,000 flat credit for trials < $50k, 4% credit on first invoice for deals >= $50k.
4) Anchor/demo attribution: Lumos-run demos will be treated as partner-introduced for registration provided the intake form and meeting notes are shared within 48 hours.
5) Clawback: if deal cancels within 90 days of conversion, revenue share will be reconciled pro-rata and Lumos may need to return incentives.

Next steps: legal to exchange a short reseller addendum (we'll start from our redwood_term_sheet_draft.pdf) and ops to wire up registration intake (we can use your Google form or switch to our DocuSign PowerForm). Please confirm whether Lumos prefers DocuSign (link below) or Google form so we can choose the integration path.

Attachment: redwood_term_sheet_draft.pdf (term sheet, 2 pages)
Related link (DocuSign powerform): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=LumosDealReg

If that looks acceptable we'll route to legal today and aim for a signed addendum within 10 business days. Once signed, we'll enable a partner registration queue in our console and provide monthly reporting on registered leads and conversions.

Marissa Cole
Head of Channel & GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0367
